fields.label: Operators
fields.description: Who may run OneAdmin. The workspace's administrators are its first operators.

fields.label: Frappe Cloud
fields.description: Credentials for the Frappe Cloud account that hosts customer sites.

fields.label: Press Root Domain
fields.description: The Frappe Cloud root domain sites are created on, for example frappe.cloud.

fields.label: Environment
fields.description: Production leaves this blank. Any other name, like dev, is added to each Worker, store, bucket, gateway and token setup makes.

fields.label: Master Token
fields.description: Made in Cloudflare from the Create Additional Tokens template. Set Up Cloudflare uses it only to make One's own tokens.

fields.label: OneAdmin Token
fields.description: Made by Set Up Cloudflare for OneAdmin's own calls, and made again when its secret is lost.

fields.label: Workers KV Namespace
fields.description: The Workers KV namespace the edge router reads. The API token needs edit access to this namespace only.

fields.label: Zone ID
fields.description: The zone the workspace domain is in. Customers' own domains are added to it as custom hostnames.
Base domain for workspace addresses. Example: t.4dl.app
fields.label: Workspace Domain
Mail Domain
fields.description: Workspaces get their mail addresses here, for example m.4dl.app. It may be in another zone than the workspace domain.

fields.label: Set Up Cloudflare
fields.description: Finds or makes everything a workspace needs from Cloudflare. Running it again checks it all and mends what is missing.

fields.label: Storage
fields.description: R2 buckets. A workspace is a prefix in one of them, fixed by its jurisdiction.

fields.label: R2 Access Key ID
fields.description: The OneAdmin Storage token, made by Set Up Cloudflare and allowed only the two buckets.

fields.label: Stripe
fields.description: Checkout and webhook credentials. Webhook signature checks fail without the webhook secret.

fields.label: Publishable Key
fields.description: Starts with pk_live_ or pk_test_. Used by checkout pages and safe to expose.

fields.label: Gateway Name
fields.description: The AI Gateway on the Cloudflare account above.

fields.label: Gateway Token
fields.description: The OneAI token, made by Set Up Cloudflare. Provider keys are stored in the gateway, never here.

fields.label: OpenWeather Key
fields.description: One Call API 4.0. Workspaces near one place share its reading.

fields.label: Credits
fields.description: What an AI call costs a workspace. What a credit sells for is the credit packs' price, in the price list.

fields.label: Credits per Dollar
fields.description: How many credits one dollar of provider cost becomes, before markup. Not the price of a credit.

fields.label: Default Markup
fields.description: Multiplied onto provider cost. 2 charges twice the provider's price.

fields.label: Costs
fields.description: A month, in the price list's currency. The Price Check and the Plan Calculator price from these.

fields.label: Per Workspace
fields.description: Monthly cost of one workspace's Frappe Cloud site at the smallest size, including mail.

fields.label: Per GB of Storage
fields.description: Files in R2.

fields.label: Per GB of Database
fields.description: What each GB of database adds to the site's Frappe Cloud plan.

fields.label: Per GB of Backup
fields.description: One backup copy of one GB of database, kept a month.

fields.label: Backups Kept
fields.description: How many copies of the database are kept at any time.

fields.label: Least Margin
fields.description: The least a price may be over its cost. 2 means twice.

fields.label: Grace Periods
fields.description: Days at each status before moving to the next. Zero disables the move.

fields.label: Overdue For
fields.description: Nothing changes for the workspace during this period.

fields.label: Suspended For
fields.description: The site stops serving. Data is retained.

fields.label: Archived For
fields.description: The site is deleted, after an offsite backup. Files are deleted at the end of this period.

fields.label: Sender Email
fields.description: Sign-in links, signups and notices to customers come from this address. It must be in the workspace or mail domain's zone.

fields.label: Bench Group
fields.description: The one bench group every workspace runs on, added to each server below. It must carry erpnext, hrms and onedesk.

fields.label: Site Plan
fields.description: The free Frappe Cloud plan each site on these servers takes. It sets only its CPU time a day.

fields.label: Servers
fields.description: Where new workspaces are built. Each goes on the emptiest open server that may take it.
